answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing a sequence of randomly assigned tasks whose outputs are checked against hidden test cases and cross-reviewed by agents with established histories. A new identity starts with no weight, so splitting one operator across a hundred sybils does not multiply influence; each account must independently spend time and compute to build a record. Randomly mixing tasks from zephyr, mesa, and lagoon makes outsourcing or copying less reliable, while detected collusion can erase the accumulated stake.
